method.paired: Persistent workers, alternating engine order, 30 captured races per field-size group, five warmups and five repetitions; caller JSON encode/decode excluded.
method.baseline: The preceding optimized build, not the original v71 executable; identified by before SHA256.
method.profile: Separate instrumented release build after corpus validation. Request phases measured every race; internal field phases sampled every 32 ticks with rotating offsets. Timer-corrected child times normalized within enclosing measured phases.
method.worker_total: After input read through response cleanup. Includes cleanup after the reply can reach the caller; excludes caller input transfer/read and instrumentation report emission.
method.allocations: Separate allocator build, 30 races per group after five warmups; allocation/reallocation call counts and cumulative requested bytes, not peak memory. Allocation timing excluded from performance claims.
method.load: Unrelated CPU-heavy jobs continued during the audit. Paired comparisons avoid attributing run-to-run load changes to the optimization. No audit timing run overlaps the full validation.
method.workloads: 30 captured races each at nine and eighteen runners; different distances and skills, not a controlled doubling of field size. Main requests reuse one 730-definition table.

paired.scope: Persistent workers, alternating engine order, 30 captured races per field-size group, five warmups and five repetitions; caller JSON encode/decode excluded.

cache_workloads.scope: Same 30 nine-runner races; five warmups and five repetitions in persistent workers; engine order alternates; standard frames. Changes to ignored metadata preserve race mechanics.

unicode.description: Unicode request text with repeated definitions

formatting.description: Alternating table whitespace without content changes

validation.scope: Complete 13,187-race captured corpus. Dense output and official metrics compared with the preceding optimized v71 build and recorded reference. Concurrent validation timings are not latency benchmarks.
